look_here_first: Robust broad-leaved spiderwort, usually taller and wider-leaved than granite spiderwort.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: midstem leaves commonly 2 to 5 cm wide

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stems commonly glabrous or nearly so

lookalikes.differences: Taller and broader-leaved than T. pedicellata; generally more robust and less consistently hairy than T. hirsutiflora.
